english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession.
chiru: Inia Ananias iti miring `khat na ama inkonu Sapphira le rejet a ram `khat hi rujor.

english: And he kept back part of the proceeds, his wife also being aware of it, and brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles' feet.
chiru: Ama na, ama inkonu le rejet a, ikhawn shier kha eshen rurawt, khan khoikhat kha ruchawi a tirtawn hai keshun a vak tet.

english: But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and keep back part of the price of the land for yourself?
chiru: Inia Peter na ruti, Ananias, ijar a Satan na nang mulung kha ibuk a Ratha Riethieng chung a mielieishiei inawmawthaw a makha ram man kha eshen nangirawt maw nih?

english: While it remained, was it not your own? And after it was sold, was it not in your own control? Why have you conceived this thing in your heart? You have not lied to men but to God.
chiru: Nangjor mala khan makha nang tah anih boi maw nih? Nangjor sholeawm shier chung khan nang cham a awm boi maw nih? Ijar a nang mulung shung a hiti chon hi nangirashak maw nih? Nang na miring hai dieng mielieishiei nangithaw nimak a Pathien dieng mielieshiei nangithaw inih.

english: Then Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and breathed his last. So great fear came upon all those who heard these things.
chiru: Ananias na hihai chawng hi rujet phakhan, pur a ruthi joi, khan hihai chon ajet miring kholok na ajeng a chitna runiei uh.

english: And the young men arose and wrapped him up, carried him out, and buried him.
chiru: Rothar hai na va ua rok kha vak jo uh, khashole ruchawi ua vak khum u joi.

english: Now it was about three hours later when his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
chiru: Khan nidan `thum dawr hi rakar `le ashok chon kha jet boi a ama inkonu kha vak lut.

english: And Peter answered her, Tell me whether you sold the land for so much? She said, Yes, for so much.
chiru: Peter na ama dieng rurawdawn, Ram kha kha jat khan a nangijor u maw nih? Ama na rumashang, Inih, kha jat khan a kijor u inih.

english: Then Peter said to her, How is it that you have agreed together to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.
chiru: Peter na ama dieng ruti, Itia Pumi Ratha kha enretena rang, rawjawtshom maw nangnih uh? Enro, nang inkopa akhum miring hai na mawkawt kung ah ding a awmlai, nangawm nawchawi u rangnih joi.

english: Then immediately she fell down at his feet and breathed her last. And the young men came in and found her dead, and carrying her out, buried her by her husband.
chiru: Relentak a ama kha rupur a eke kung a ruthi joi. Rothar hai na va ua athi kha vak muk u phakhan, ruchawi ua ama inkopa diengtak khan vak khum u joi.

english: So great fear came upon all the church and upon all who heard these things.
chiru: Khajarkhan biekrup le khahai ajet kholok chung a chitna jong shok joi.

english: And through the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. And they were all with one accord in Solomon's Porch.
chiru: Khan tirtawn hai khut dieng jetna le rekhekchon tampui hi miring hai kar a ruthawna. Khan amani lawpsheng ua mulung khatte a Solomon Tomai`in khan ruruchun uh.

english: Yet none of the rest dared join them, but the people esteemed them highly.
chiru: Mi hai na amani kha rashangtak a ruen uh, khan tute na amani dieng rujaw ngam u mak.

english: And believers were increasingly added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women,
chiru: Inia Pumi takashawn nupang apa tampui kha rubo uh.

english: so that they brought the sick out into the streets and laid them on beds and couches, that at least the shadow of Peter passing by might fall on some of them.
chiru: Khajarkhan Peter na vak pang pha a, ama riliptak a kha nita`awm, amani dieng chona rang, ruti ua ana miring hai kha lamlien khan jana le pher chung ah rumaja uh.

english: Also a multitude gathered from the surrounding cities to Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits, and they were all healed.
chiru: Diengvai ah awm mipui kholok na Jerusalem ah vak ruchun ua, amani na ana miring hai le raikho rono na ichutna miring hai kha vak chawi uh, khan amani lawpsheng a damna rumuk uh.

english: Then the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with indignation,
chiru: Khashole thiempu rashang na ama le rawtawp Sadducee lawpreshen kholok le ruthoi joi. Manarshie kha na amani kha rubuk joi.

english: and laid their hands on the apostles and put them in the common prison.
chiru: Amani na tirtawn hai kha rushur ua mithat miring hai thongna lungroko shung ah rutet u joi.

english: But at night an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors and brought them out, and said,
chiru: Inia Pumi ravantir na jan a lungroko mawkawt hai kha rumawlawng pe a vai rumoshok uh, khan ruti,

english: Go, stand in the temple and speak to the people all the words of this life.
chiru: She u rang roh, riethiengmun ah vak ding u tana mahi ringna chawng kholok hi mi hai dieng vak riei pe u roh.

english: And when they heard that, they entered the temple early in the morning and taught. But the high priest and those with him came and called the council together, with all the elders of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
chiru: Amani na mahi rujet u phakhan, kha jingkar khan jingkara riethiengmun ah rulut ua mi hai kha ruruchuk u joi. Thiempu rashang na ama le rawtawp hai kha le vak shok phakhan, Sanhedrin le Israel nai hai shierpui rikip ruruchun ua, amani kha lungroko shung ah put ah vak chawina rang, mi rutir uh.

english: But when the officers came and did not find them in the prison, they returned and reported,
chiru: Inia mirung hai kha na rushe u phakhan, amani na lungroko shung khan tirtawn hai kha vak muh u lai mak. Khajarkhan vak kir ua thang vak koi uh.

english: saying, Indeed we found the prison shut securely, and the guards standing outside before the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside!
chiru: Kieini na lungroko kha thatak a rakhar, mirung hai kha mawkawt ah ading kha`awm kumuk uh, inia kawmawlawng u phakhan, shung ah tute muh u mi`ing.

english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these things, they wondered what the outcome would be.
chiru: Khan thiempu rashang hai, riethiengmun arung lamkai, khan thiempu ulien hai na hihaihi rujet u phakhan, imaw shok nih, tia shindawngna runiei uh.

english: So one came and told them, saying, Look, the men whom you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people!
chiru: Khalaitak khan miring `khat vak shok a vak rophong, Enro, lungroko shung ah nangikhum u hai kha na riethiengmun ah ding a mi hai kha ruchuk a awm uh.

english: Then the captain went with the officers and brought them without violence, for they feared the people, lest they should be stoned.
chiru: Khan lamkaipa kha na mirung hai kha le rushe a rawmawreshem moshok boi a amani kha vak chawi uh, ajarla mi hai kha na lung le nedeng u nih, tia ruchih uh.

english: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council. And the high priest asked them,
chiru: Amani na vak chawi u phakhan, Sanhedrin maikung a rumiding ua thiempu rashang kha na amani dieng rurawdawn,

english: saying, Did we not strictly command you not to teach in this name? And look, you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this Man's blood on us!
chiru: khan ama na ruti, Mahi riming hin mi ruchukna boi rang, kieini na chawngkinabenrep u nimak maw? Inia enro, nangiruchuk u kha na Jerusalem hi ship joi. Hi miring thishen kha kieini dieng nangmocho jawt uh.

english: But Peter and the other apostles answered and said: We ought to obey God rather than men.
chiru: Inia Peter le tirtawn hai na mashang a ruti uh, Miring hainek khan Pathien chawng kha kirangai u rang a shok.

english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus whom you murdered by hanging on a tree.
chiru: Thingling ah nangirumakhai ua nangiruthat u Jesu kha nipilepu hai Pathien kha na irumothoi inih.

english: Him God has exalted to His right hand to be Prince and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.
chiru: Pathien na Israel hai dieng mulung lekna le munu rangaidamna pekna rang, Rengshapa le Shandampa `khat a, ukhut chang tieng awmna rang, rumulur joi.

english: And we are His witnesses to these things, and so also is the Holy Spirit whom God has given to those who obey Him.
chiru: Khan hihai jar hin kieini na kungachang kanih uh. Pathien na ama chawng rangai miring hai dieng ipek Ratha Riethieng na`awm hihai chungchang hin kungachang u inih.

english: When they heard this, they were furious and plotted to kill them.
chiru: Amani na mahi rujet u phakhan, ajeng a mulung ruhang pe ua amani kha thatna rang, lam rutawk u joi.

english: Then one in the council stood up, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law held in respect by all the people, and commanded them to put the apostles outside for a little while.
chiru: Inia mi kholok na richit ipek, Dan oja, Gamaliel iti Pharisee miring `khat na Sanhedrin khan ruding a tirtawn hai kha vai ah tetbawtna rang, chawng rupek.

english: And he said to them: Men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what you intend to do regarding these men.
chiru: Khashole amani dieng ruti, Israel miring hai, hihai miring dieng hin thaw rang nangiti u kha miningrep u roh.

english: For some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody. A number of men, about four hundred, joined him. He was slain, and all who obeyed him were scattered and came to nothing.
chiru: Ajartu kum `khat le `di mala khan Theudas iti miring `khat ruawm, ama na kiei kanih, tia miring rajamili dawr na ama anu rujui uh, inia ama kha ruthat uh. Khan ama rungamna miring kholok kha`awm chekrurachai ua ruthangsho u joi.

english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the census, and drew away many people after him. He also perished, and all who obeyed him were dispersed.
chiru: Ama shole, Judas iti Galilee miring `khat ruthoi. Mijattelai khan mitampui na ama anu kha rujui uh. Ama`awm khatikhan ruthang a ama rungamna miring hai kha chekrurachai uh.

english: And now I say to you, keep away from these men and let them alone; for if this plan or this work is of men, it will come to nothing;
chiru: Khajarkhan tunawm chonmun hi nangni dieng kinieriei u inih: hihai miring hi ralat pui u roh, ithaw jawt kha thaw u rosho. Hihai chonmun hai hi manmieshie miring na irashak chonmun nitatu, thang rang keng.

english: but if it is of God, you cannot overthrow it - lest you even be found to fight against God.
chiru: Inia mahi Pathien ah put ah nitatu, mathang ngam u naw tinih. Pathien le rosho nangchang u rang keng.

english: And they agreed with him, and when they had called for the apostles and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
chiru: Amani kha khatikhan ama na rumawjawt. Khashole amani na tirtawn hai kha koi ua, rujem uh. Khan Jesu riming a chawngriei tha mak, tia chawngrubenrep ua rumoshok u joi.

english: So they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for His name.
chiru: Sanhedrin kha irumathan u le roroia, ama riming jar a maimawk rang a kha Pathien na irutukmashak inih, tia ningaina kha runiei uh.

english: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they did not cease teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ.
chiru: Khan ningthingkip hin riethiengmun ah nit a in ah nita`awm, Jesu hi Christa inih, iti kha ruchuh le rophong ruchat u mak.
